text:
Priya: Heads-up 1 - legal asked us to tweak the billing override modal copy. It's the modal users see when applying a promo to reserved capacity. Need clear language + a11y checks.
Ethan: Paste current copy?
Priya: Current: 'Apply promotion? This will override committed usage discounts and may change your invoice.' Primary: 'Apply' Secondary: 'Cancel'
Jules: Vague: 'may change your invoice' is too soft. Also 'Apply' as a verb is blunt.
A11yTeam: For screen readers, avoid starting with a question mark sentence. Use declarative lead, then the consequence.
Priya: Proposed option A (short): header: 'Apply promotion' body: 'This promotion will replace your committed discount for the billing period and may increase or decrease charges.' action: 'Apply promotion' cancel: 'Cancel'
Ethan: Option A still a bit fuzzy. 'Replace your committed discount' could sound like it removes discounts entirely.
Jules: Option B (explicit): header: 'Apply promotion to reserved capacity' body: 'Applying this promotion will temporarily override your committed discount rate for the current billing cycle. Your invoice may increase or decrease based on the new rate. Taxes and billing dates are unaffected.' action: 'Confirm and apply' cancel: 'Back'
A11yTeam: Prefer B for clarity. Also recommend adding a live region announcement: 'Notice: billing rates will change for the current cycle.' Use role="status" not role="alert" so it's polite but still read.
Priya: Are we allowed to say 'temporarily override'? Legal wants 'temporary' only if it aligns with billing system. 
Ethan: Billing confirms: promo replaces discount until next billing cycle or until promo expires. So "temporarily" is OK.
Jules: Microcopy nit: 'invoice' -> 'invoice (charges)' might confuse. Maybe use 'final invoice for the current billing cycle'.
A11yTeam: Also avoid parentheses; screen readers read them awkwardly. Spell it out: 'final invoice for the current billing cycle.'
Priya: Final suggested body: 'Applying this promotion will temporarily override your committed discount rate for the current billing cycle. Your final invoice for the cycle may increase or decrease based on the new rate. Taxes and billing dates will not change.'
Ethan: Button label: prefer 'Apply promotion' vs 'Confirm and apply' 1 - consistency with other billing modals uses 'Apply X' as verb.
Jules: Make primary color-state destructive? It's not destructive but it changes billing so keep regular primary. Avoid red.
DesignBot: Checklist: declarative header, explicit consequence, avoid parentheses, include aria-live (role=status), aria-describedby on primary button pointing to body, consistent button verb, no ambiguous 'may affect' language.
A11yTeam: Keyboard focus: focus trap into modal, initial focus on the heading, then ensure screen reader reads the body via aria-describedby. Provide an optional visually-hidden summary for screen readers: 'Billing change preview: final invoice may change.'
Priya: Great. I'll update the copy in figma and add a note for devs to include role=status live region and aria-describedby on the primary button. Will loop in legal for sign-off. Thanks :white_check_mark:
